trust_decision.summary: A ComponentDefinition (or a capability object handed to the CLI) names a remote git URL, but the content of that repository and the on-disk clone cache under $HOME/.vela/terraform/<name> are untrusted: the loader must bound what it reads and contain it to the cache. At the pinned commit the decision is taken in GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote, which clones (or reuses a cache directory it never validates) and then os.ReadFile's variables.tf/main.tf with no size, type or containment check.

landing_point.why: An engineer reading only 'DoS via unbounded file read in the Terraform remote loader' lands on the os.ReadFile(filepath.Clean(tfPath)) of the cloned repository's variables.tf/main.tf, with tfPath built at capability.go:231-236 from cachePath + remotePath.

fix_sites.entry_point: ComponentDefinition reconcile -> CapabilityComponentDefinition.StoreOpenAPISchema (pkg/controller/core.oam.dev/v1beta1/core/components/componentdefinition/componentdefinition_controller.go:89, call at capability.go:379); also the CLI `vela show`/reference generation path (references/cli/show.go:89 -> references/docgen/markdown.go:326 -> references/docgen/parser.go:472)
fix_sites.module_kind: controller reconcile plus CLI/library path, both through the shared pkg/controller/utils util package

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The second entry point is a developer-facing doc/CLI path (`vela show`, markdown reference generation), not the controller whose DoS the advisory describes, so a solver can argue it was never the protected surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Reusing an already-populated module cache without cloning: the pinned unit test pre-populates $HOME/.vela/terraform/<name>/<remotePath>/<file> and passes a remote URL that must not be contacted, and it expects main.tf to be accepted when variables.tf is absent. A fix that always re-clones, or that refuses any pre-existing cache outright, breaks this.

O6_input_shapes: regular variables.tf (preferred) with main.tf as fallback
variables.tf that is a symlink to a file outside the cache
variables.tf reached through a symlinked parent directory that escapes the cache
lexical ../ traversal in the definition's remotePath with no symlink anywhere
a symlink whose target is a regular file inside the cache (deliberately rejected too)
a regular file exactly at the 1 MiB cap and one byte over it
module name that is empty, '.', '..' or contains '/', steering the cache path and its RemoveAll
a changed remote URL while a populated cache exists (marker mismatch forces re-clone)
an authenticated HTTPS/scp-style URL with embedded credentials (redaction for logs and marker)
a clone whose retained byte total or entry count exceeds the caps

O7_producer.where: pkg/controller/utils/capability.go:212-227 (the $HOME/.vela/terraform/<name> clone cache, populated by git.PlainClone at line 224 in an earlier reconcile; the fix adds a sibling .remote-url marker written by recordCacheRemote)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: CLI doc generation reaches the same sink: vela show -> docgen.ParseReference -> parseTerraformCapabilityParameters -> GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote, in packages the published fix never touched
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Doc/markdown generation is a CLI/developer tool, not the controller whose DoS the advisory reports; a fix placed in StoreOpenAPISchema (capability.go:379) is enough for the advisory.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: 2 packages / 2 files (references/docgen, references/cli) from the landing point; reachable only through the shared util package, so a sink-level fix covers it but a caller-level fix does not

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a TraitDefinition branch that supports schematic.terraform.type=remote and calls the same loader
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: CapabilityTraitDefinition.StoreOpenAPISchema exists beside the component one and today ignores Terraform; extending terraform support to traits is a natural maintainer change and would add a second caller of the protected sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an addon/CLI terraform path that joins a user-controlled component name into .vela/terraform/<name> and works on that directory
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same '.vela/terraform' cache convention and the same class of user-controlled name, written by the same authors; reading the module directory before terraform runs would be a believable sibling loader.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: the git-credentials step writing Secret-supplied known_hosts material to a temp file next to the clone, with no size or containment bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The fix's own theme is bounding attacker-adjacent data written/read around the clone; hardening this write with the same size/containment helpers is a plausible maintainer addition.

O9_family: CWE-59 link following / path containment failure enabling CWE-400 uncontrolled resource consumption in a remote Terraform configuration loader (symlink, FIFO, oversize file, unbounded clone)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.23.8 (go.mod:3); `go build ./...`; Makefile `test: envtest unit-test-core test-cli-gen` (Makefile:15,25-26)
O10_build.project_tests: pkg/controller/utils/capability_test.go (unit, includes TestGetOpenAPISchemaFromTerraformComponentDefinition at :217), pkg/controller/utils/capability_config_test.go (offline loader test, pre-populates the cache), pkg/controller/utils/capability_suite_test.go (ginkgo suite that starts envtest in BeforeSuite, so KUBEBUILDER_ASSETS is needed unless filtered with -run), pkg/controller/utils/capability_integrate_test.go, references/docgen/parser_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Wrap the existing os.ReadFile in io.LimitReader, or add an os.Stat size check, inside GetTerraformConfigurationFromRemote and stop - leaving the symlink/FIFO escapes, the clone caps and the URL-keyed cache reuse unhandled.

out_of_scope_notes: fix.diff additionally touches pkg/controller/core.oam.dev/v1beta1/application/application_controller.go and .../application/apply.go (appliedResourcesWithCreator / sameResource, re-attaching creator attribution to app.status.appliedResources); that is unrelated to this advisory (it matches the pinned code at application_controller.go:323) and is excluded from fix_sites and O1.
